ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Arfin India Limited reported robust consolidated financial results for Q1 FY27 (quarter ended June 30, 2026), with revenue more than doubling and net profit almost quadrupling compared to the same period last year. While sequential revenue grew from the previous quarter, net profit saw a noticeable decline, primarily influenced by a significant increase in inventory. The unaudited results were subjected to an unqualified limited review by statutory auditors, indicating no immediate material red flags.
